tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /thugs rje chen po'i dmar khrid nges don dpyid kyi thig le zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mas+saṅgu ru pa dā ya/ thugs rje chen po'i dmar khrid nges don dpyid kyi thig le zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha mchog mgon po spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi ma bcos rang mdangs gsal ba'i gshis/ /gshis lugs snying rjes dbang bsgyur tshogs gnyis phul/ /phul phyin dpag med bskal pa'i sngon du grub/ /grub nas mgon gyur pad dkar 'dzin khyod rgyal/ /mgon khyod sgrub thabs khyod kyi gdul bya'i zhing / /bsil ldan ljongs kyi grub chen gyis bkral ba'i/ /thugs rje'i dmar khrid rang gzhan thar pa cher/ /'khrid byed gdams pa 'dir spel brtse bas skyongs/ /yi dam thugs rje chen po'i dmar khrid tshem bu lugs su grags pa 'chad cing nyams su len pa la slob ma rnal 'byor bla med kyi dbang thob pa dam tshig dang ldan pa rnams kyis phyag dang maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba sngon du 'gro bas 'khod pa la/ slob dpon gyis zang zing med pa'i snying rje chen po sngon du btang zhing / lhag pa'i lha'i nga rgyal brtan po dang ldan pa'i 'di skad du gdams par bya'o/ /'o nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du gdams pa zab mo gsan la don nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam pa byang chub kyi mchog tu thugs bskyed pa dang / chos gsan pa'i kun tu spyod pa rnams kyang theg pa che chung rnams nas ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin gsal btab nas gsan par zhu/ de la gsan rgyu'i chos ni/ bla ma rnams kyis snyan nas snyan du brgyud pa bar ma chad pa'i mkha' 'gro'i gsang chos/ sgrub thabs gcig shes pas yi dam thams cad kyi sgrub thabs thams cad shes par byed pa/ gang zag gcig 'tshang rgya ba'i lam tshang la ma nor ba yin pa lam cha tshang /

sdig po che btsan thams su 'tshang rgya ba'i man ngag spyir yi dam thams cad dang dgos thugs rje chen po'i dmar khrid ces bya ba ste/ mtshan gyi rnam grangs drug dang ldan pa'i lam bzang 'di 'chad par byed pa la gsum ste/ theg pa dang mdo rgyud gang du gtogs ngos bzung ba/ ngos zin pa de gang las byung ba'i bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam par bstan pa/ brgyud pa de ldan gyi gdams pa dngos bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ bstan pa 'di'i bdag po ston pa mnyam med shākya'i rgyal pos/ gdul bya rnams kyis bsam pa dang bag la nyal sna tshogs la dgongs nas/ dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi bsam gyis mi khyab pa gsungs te/ 'phags mchog klu sgrub zhabs kyis/ 'jig rten dbye ba rnam mang la/ /thabs tshul rnam pa sna tshogs kyis/ /sems can bsam dang rjes mthun par/ /'jig rten mgon po rnams kyis bstan/ /zhes so/ /de thams cad bsdu na/ 'dod chags la sogs pa'i dug gsum dang / de gsum cha mnyam pa ste/ nyon mongs pa nyis khri chig stong phrag bzhi la spyod pa'i gnyen po chos kyi sgo mo brgyad khri bzhi stong du 'dus te/ dkon mchog ta la'i gzungs las/ stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi gang yin pas/ /rgyal ba gang dag 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i/ /chos kyi bye brag sgo mo de snyed kyis/ /bsam pa ji bzhin 'jig rten sems can 'dul/ /zhes so/ /de yang bsdu na gdul bya nyan thos la sogs pa'i rigs can gsum gyi nyams su blang bya theg pa gsum du 'dus te/ 'phags pa rdo rje snying por/ theg pa gsum gyi nges 'byung la/ /theg pa gcig gi 'bras bur gnas/ /sangs rgyas pa la bzhi pa dang / /lnga pa thub pa'i dgongs pa min/ /zhes so/ /de ltar las 'di theg pa chen po yin la/ de nyid nyan rang gi theg pa las khyad par 'phags pa'i tshul ni/ byang chub mchog tu smon pa dang 'jug pa'i sems bskyed pa gnyis dang / don dam spros bral dang kun rdzob rgyu 'bras bslu med du shes nas/

tshogs gnyis sgrub pa zab cing rgya che ba dang / gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu 'khor ba dang / theg dman du mi zlog pa dang / mthar thug gi 'bras bu rnam mkhyen thob par byed pa ste/ khyad chos lngas khyad par 'phags la/ tshul gsum sgron me las/ smon pa dang ni 'jug pa dang / /de bzhin zab dang rgya che dang / /mi zlog 'bras bu thob pas kyang / /theg pa chen po khyad par 'phags/ /zhes so/ /khyad par 'phags pa'i theg chen de yang gdul bya la ltos nas gnyis su 'gyur te/ gdul bya dbang rtul rgyu la mos shing lam du byed pa la rgyu'i theg pa dang / dbang rnon 'bras bu la mos shing 'bras bu lam du byed pa la 'bras bu'i theg pa gsungs te/ rdo rje theg pa'i mtha' gnyis sel ba las/ rgyu la mos pa rgyu chos kyi/ /'khor lo rab tu bskor byas nas/ /rdo rje theg pa'i nye lam zhig /ma 'ongs dus na 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa de'i rgyu'i theg pa las/ 'bras bu'i theg pa gzhi lam 'bras bu'i chos gsum gyi khyad par 'phags te/ grub chen ḍom+bhī bas/ 'di ni snod kyi khyad par dang / /snod du bya ba'i chos dang ni/ /'bras bu dag gi khyad par gyis/ /gsang sngags theg pa khyad par 'phags/ /zhes so/ /sngags kyi theg pa de la dbye na/ rgyud so so'i dgongs pa dang mkhas grub rnams kyis bzhed pa mi 'dra ba'i dbang gis/ rgyud sde gnyis su 'dod pa nas/ drug tu 'dod pa'i bar du yod pa las 'dir rgyud sde bzhir bzhed pa'i phyogs yin/ de la gdul bya dbang po dman pa la sogs pa bzhi'i don du/ bya ba/ spyod pa/ rnal 'byor/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud dang bzhi gsungs te/ rdo rje gur las/ dman pa rnams la bya ba'i rgyud/ /bya min rnal 'byor de ltag la/ /sems can mchog la rnal 'byor mchog /rnal 'byor gong ma de ltag la/ /zhes so/ /de ltar bzhi las 'di rnal 'byor bla na med pa yin/ bla na med pa'i rgyud kyi nyams len la/

rgyud kyi dngos bstan las byung ba dang / grub pa'i dbang phyug rnams kyis man ngag gis bkral ba gnyis las/ 'di phyi ma yin/ de la rgya bod kyi skyes chen rnams la mi 'dra ba du ma yod pa las/ 'di bod kyi grub chen tshem bu par grags pa la/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro mas dngos su gnang ba'i gdams ngag yin/ gnyis pa ni gdams pa 'di'i brgyud pa'i gtso bo grub chen tshem bu pa de nyid yin la/ de'i sku che ba'i yon tan ni/ 'khrungs yul gtsang gi shab stod pa/ gdung gnyan/ mtshan dngos dar ma 'od zer zhes bya la/ 'di ni skyes stobs kyis mkhyen brtse phul du byung ba dang ldan pas/ sbyangs stobs kyi thos bsam mthar phyin te/ sgom stobs kyis bdud rtsi myang bar bzhed nas/ dus rgyun du tshe 'di snang gi spros pa thams cad mchil ma'i thal ba bzhin du dor nas/ 'phral gyi 'tsho chas ngan ngon gang rnyed kyis chog shes par mdzad cing / khyad par na bza' hrul po la lhan pa mang po btab nas bsnams pas/ mtshan yang tshem bu pa zhes grags so/ /de ltar 'dod don la sred pa spangs nas/ thos bsam gyi 'bras bu sgom pa kho na la thugs gzhol bar mdzad pas/ mthong thos kun gyis phyi nang mtshungs pa'i skyes bu dam par 'dzin cing khyad par du gtsang chu sgo gzhung stod kyi chos grwa chu mig ring mo dang / bye spe'i lho thad ston mo lung gi dgon pa'i bdag po dge ba'i bshes gnyen sngog btsun dkar mo zhes bya bas/ phyi nang gi yon tan legs par rtogs nas dad pa chen pos dgon pa ston mo lung phul nas 'gro phan mdzad par zhus pas/ 'di lta bu 'dod pa gzhan yod pas de la phul gsungs nas ma bzhes par/ g.yas ru'i phyogs rta nag brag gseb la sogs par sgrub pa rtse gcig tu mdzad pas/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i zhal gzigs nas chos 'di thob cing nyams su blangs pas/ thugs rje chen po'i zhal gzigs shing grub pa brnyes/

de'i tshe 'khor rnams la kho bo sngog btsun dkar mo'i tshe 'thor ma zug pa'i mi yin gsung nas zhal pho yang mdzad do/ /de lta bu'i yon tan dpag tu med pa mnga' ba'i grub chen de dben par sgrub pa kho na la dges pas chos thob pa'i slob ma nyung zhing / bye brag tu gdams pa 'di la bka' shin tu dog pas/ skal ldan gyi slob ma drug las gzhan la ma gnang ngo / /drug ni byang sems spyi bo lhas pa/ nyid kyi nye gnas 'che brag pa/ rong yul lha dgon pa'i dge bshes gcig 'bring 'tshams btsan lung gi slob dpon jo sras/ nyid kyi gcung po dbang phyug grags/ dge bshes sdog btsun dkar mo dang drug la gnang zhing / khong rnams kyis bsgoms pas grub pa thob bo/ /khong rnams kyis brgyud pa dris pas/ brgyud pas ci byed/ 'di mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs thul le ba'i chos yin/ khyed rnams gzhan la bshad snyam 'dug ste/ 'di gang dran dran la bshad rgyu'i chos ma yin/ rang gis nyams su blang rgyu'i chos yin gsung nas brgyud pa dris pa la mi mnyes skad do/ /de ltar skal ldan gyi don mdzad cing sgrub pa rtse gcig pa'i ring nas/ mthar chos 'di'i 'da' kha ma zab mo la brten nas mya ngan las 'das so/ /zhes bla ma brgyud pa'i gsung sgros thor bu las 'byung la/ 'di'i rnam thar rgyas pa btsal yang ma rnyed do/ /grub chen des slob ma drug la snang yang / deng sang chos kyi brgyud pa la yod pa ni spyi bo lhas pa dang / nye gnas 'che brag pa gnyis yin la/ dang po'i lo rgyus ni/ mtshan dngos byang chub 'od/ bzhugs sa bo dong gi nub ri'i dgon pa spyi bo lhas yin pas/ gnas kyi ming gang zag la btags nas de skad du grags so/ /sbyangs pa'i yon tan sde snod mtha' dag la mkhas shing / rtogs pa'i yon tan theg chen byang sems bcos min rgyud la mnga' ba/ phrin las kyis thub pa'i bstan pa spel zhing gdul bya mang po'i 'dren par gyur pa yin la/

'on kyang chos thams cad gcig tu dril nas nyams su len tshul gyi lung bstan zhu ba dang / rang gzhan gyi bsod nams spel ba'i phyir/ lha sar jo bo'i drung du gsol ba 'debs pa dang / skor ba mdzad pa la byon pas/ bla ma gnyan dang mjal/ chos kyis gsung gleng mdzad pas grub thob tu mkhyen nas/ rjes su 'dzin par zhus pas phyi mtshan nyid theg pa'i lam cha tshang rin spungs kyi don khrid dang / nang gsang sngags theg pa'i lam cha tshang dmar khrid 'di gnang zhing byin gyis brlabs so/ /de phyin chad chos gcig tu dril nas nyams su len tshul mkhyen/ bsgoms pa grub pa thob nas gzhan phan rgya chen po mdzad do/ /nye gnas pa ni chu sgo gzhung stod kyi snar dang / de'i phu lag rdza lung zhes pa'i bar na 'che brag zer ba'i dben gnas yod cing / der bzhugs pas mtshan de ltar grags la/ khong gis grub pa thob nas lho brag na mar byon pas/ lho brag ras pa bya ba'i grags pa yang byung skad/ gzhan lo rgyus rgyas pa'i yig ge mi snang yang / grub chen la chos 'di gsan nas bsgoms pas dngos grub thob nges pa'o/ /de gnyis las ji ltar brgyud pa'i tshul ni/ byang chub sems dpa' spyi bo lhas pa'i drung du/ stag sde brag dmar ba byang chub tshul khrims kyis gsan/ de la lha btsun dgon gsar ba tshul khrims grags pas gsan/ de la kun spangs chen po thugs rje brtson 'grus kyis gsan/ yang 'chi brag pa'i drung du stag ston spyil bu bas gsan/ de la kun spangs chen pos gsang phu ne'u thog tu byon pas mjal te/ chos kyi gsung gleng mang du mdzad cing / thugs dam gyi mthil gang la mdzad dris pas/ thugs rje chen po'i dmar khrid la mdzad gsungs nas gsan no/ /kun spangs chen po'i mdog gi lung lag phu sla nga 'dra ba'i ngab char zhes pa'i yul du sku 'khrungs shing / cher son pa na/ rgyang ro ser sdings su bzhugs pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po/

mdo sngags chos ma lus pa la dbang 'byor pa thog mar mtshan chos kyi 'od zer zhes grags kyang / 'gro ba'i mgon po chos rgyal 'phags pas chos sku 'od zer zhes btags pas/ phyis de ltar du grags pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen de la sogs pa mang du bsten nas lung rtogs kyi yon tan du ma la mnga' brnyes shing / khyad par zab lam rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la dbang 'byor zhing / jo mo nang zhes bya ba'i dgon pa chen po de btab/ chos rje gzhi thog pa 'jam dbyangs chen po dang / mkhan chen bsod nams seng ge la sogs pa'i slob ma dbang po rno 'bring rtul gsum rnams smin grol gyi lam la bkod pa yin no/ /kun spangs nas byang sems rgyal ba ye shes/ chos rje gzhon seng ba/ 'phags mchog bsod nams mtshan can/ theg chen chos kyi rgyal po kun dga' bkra shis/ thugs sras dpal ldan legs pa/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang blo gros rgyal mtshan/ rdo ring kun spangs chen po kun bzang chos kyi nyi ma/ mkhas grub kun dga'i mtshan can/ tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug grub mchog dbang phyug rab brtan/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags/ shar rgya mkhar rtse ba byams pa ngag dbang bsod nams rgya mtshan/ bod chen gyi btsun pa bud+dha shwī bha dra/ des bdag la'o/ /yang na jo nang kun spangs pa yan gong bzhin las/ kun spangs nas/ brag kha ba grags pa seng ge dang / sgro smon pa rin chen dpal bzang / dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod rnams rgyal mtshan/ 'ba' ra ba rgyal mtshan dpal bzang / rtogs ldan rin chen 'phel/ zhwa lu pa 'khrul zhig tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ sku zhang mkhyen rab chos rje/ rdo ring pa man gong bzhin no/ /bla ma phyi ma rnams kyi lo rgyus skabs su gang babs 'chad cing / gsol 'debs dang mos gus la brtson par bya'o/ /bla ma brgyud pa'i khungs dang mi ldan na rigs med kyi nal bu dang 'dra ste yid rton du mi rung zhes gsung ngo /

/gsum pa gdams pa dngos la don gsum ste/ khrid bya'i gzhi ngos bzung ba/ khrid byed kyi thabs bstan pa/ de ltar bstan pa'i 'bras bu'o/ /dang po ni/ sems gsal stong zung 'jug gi bdag nyid/ 'gro ba thams cad la khyab pa'i gzhi bde gshegs snying po de nyid do/ /gnyis pa 'khrid byed kyi thabs la gnyis te/ gdan thog gcig tu bsgom pa'i man ngag nyams su blang tshul dang / de la gzhan pa'i man ngag nyams su blang ba'i tshul lo/ /dang po la/ sngon 'gro dang / dngos gzhi dang / rjes bsngo ba smon lam zung 'brel dang bcas pa nyams su blang ba gsum gyi/ dang po la/ thun mong gi sngon 'gro dang / thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro gnyis/ de'i dang po dal 'byor rnyed dka' dang / 'chi ba mi rtag pa bsams pa/ las rgyu 'bras dang / 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsams pa/ byams pa dang snying rje bsgom pa/ smon pa dang 'jug pa'i byang chub kyi sems bsgom zhing / de dag gi spyod pa la bslab pa rnams/ sbyor ba skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ rjes bsngo smon dang / dran shes bsten pa'i rkya bar du bcug ste nyams su blang bar bya ste/ de rnams 'khrid thams cad kyi sngon 'gro yin pas/ spyi 'gro ltar shes par bya zhing gal shin tu che ste/ thun mong gi sngon 'gro de rnams rgyud la ma skyes na/ dngos gzhi'i 'khrid btab kyang mi skye ste/ gnyid mi dro ba mal du bcug pa dang 'dra'o gsungs/ sngon 'gro de rnams kyi tshig ris ni snang gsum mdzes rgyan dang / blo sbyong sogs rang gi blo la gang 'dzin pa'i stong nas rung zhing / go rim ni gong gi sa bcad ltar bya'o/ /gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro la/ rgyud snod du rung bar byed pa skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ sdig sgrib dag par byed pa yi ge brgya pa/ tshogs rdzogs par byed pa maṇ+ḍal/ byin brlabs 'jug par byed pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid dang bzhi'i dang po la gnyis/

tha mal dang lam log pa las khyad par du bya ba skyabs 'gro dang / lam dman pa nyan rang las khyad par byed pa sems bskyed do/ /dang po skyabs 'gro la/ rgyu yul tshul dwang phan yon dang / /bslab bya sgra don dbye ba'o/ /zhes pa ltar bdun las/ rgyu ni rang gzhan sems can 'khor ba spyi dang / ngan song thams cad dang / tshe 'di'i yang mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las skyabs 'dod cing / sems dwang ba dang / rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba zab mo la yid ches pa'i sgo nas skyabs su 'gro'o/ /yul gsal btab pa ni/ rang gnas pa'i sa phyogs po ta lar bsam/ rang gi mdun du rin po che'i khri bang rim drug pa bkod pa phun gsum tshogs pa gcig bsam de'i bang rim dang po la/ rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang la/ dmar khrid brgyud pas bskor ba bzhugs pa gsal 'debs/ gnyis pa la dbus su thabs kyi sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs/ g.yas su shes rab kyi sems dpa' 'jam dbyangs/ g.yon du mthu stobs kyi sems dpa' phyag na rdo rje rnams sku mdog phyag mtshan rnams ji lta bar gsal 'debs/ gzhan yang yi dam gyi lha gang la mos pa rnams bsgoms/ gsum pa la ston pa thub pa'i dbang po la/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyis bskor ba dang / bzhi pa la chos dkon mchog ngo bo rnam byang bden pa/ rnam pa glegs bam gyi rnam pa can/ rin po che'i drwa mig na bzhugs pa/ lnga pa la dge 'dun dkon mchog theg pa che chung gi 'phags pa rnams bsgom/ drug pa la/ bka' srung chos skyong ba'i srung ma rnams bsam mo/ /tshul ni/ bla ma dkon mchog la blo lings kyis bkal/ rang gi skyabs 'gro byed pa bzhin sems can thams cad kyis byed par mos te/ bla ma dang sangs rgyas la 'dren pa/ chos la lam/ dge 'dun la zla grogs zhu bar bsam zhing bya/ ngag tu tshig lhug pa'i skyabs 'gro bzhi bskor ram/ drug bskor ram/ yang na/ bdag dang 'gro ba khams gsum nam mkha' yi/ /zhes sogs skyabs 'gro tshigs bcad ma gang rung kha tsam tshig tsam min par blo dang 'dre nges ci nus bya'o/

/thun bsdu ba'i tshe bla ma mchog dang dkon mchog rin po che/ /sogs nas/ myur du sangs rgyas thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes pa'i bar gyi gsol ba btab pas skyabs yul rnams 'od du zhu nas rang gzhan sems can thams cad la thim par bsam la/ sems khong glod la cung zad mnyam par bzhag go /de yang sems nyid skye ba med pa don dam pa'i sangs rgyas/ rang bzhin spros pa dang bral ba don dam pa'i chos/ sems nyid gdod ma nas rtogs pa'i ye shes las phyir mi ldog pa don dam pa'i dge 'dun/ de khyad par gyi dkon mchog gsum yin gsung / phan yon ni/ sdom pa thams cad skye ba'i rgyu yin pa sogs bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ phar phyin lnga bstan pa'i mdo las kyang / skyabs song bsod nams gzugs yod na/ /stong gsum 'di yang snod du chung / /zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /bslab bya ni/ skyabs gzhan mi 'tshol/ ci la thug kyang skyabs gsum mi spangs/ skyabs su song ba'i phan yon dran pas/ yang yang skyabs 'gro la goms par bya'o/ /sgra don dang dbye ba gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa sems bskyed kyi rab dbye gzhan du shes par bya zhing / 'dir smon 'jug gi go don ni/ sems can thams cad pha mar shes pa'i byams brtses kun blangs te/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya snyam pa'i sems dpa' rgyun chags ni smon pa'i go don no/ /de'i ched du bdag gi lam zab mo nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam pa'i sems dpa' rgyun chags ni 'jug pa'i go don no/ /'khrid kyi skabs su ni tshig de dag gi brgya rtsa stong rtsa la sogs pa sems dang 'gre nges/ nges shes ma skyes pa'i bar du bya'o/ /dus rgyun gyi thugs dam la ni gsum tsam brjod do/ /de nyid tshigs bcad du brjod la/ mar gyur 'gro rnams srid las bsgral ba'i phyir/ /zhes sogs sh+lo ka gcig nyid lan gsum sogs brjod pa'o/

/thun 'tshams kun du sangs rgyas chos rdzogs ma la 'bad/ bla ma'i rten gyi drung du sems bskyed blang pa'i cho ga ni/ ci 'byor pa'i mchod pa bsham ste/ bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam nas 'byung ba ltar gyi yan lag bdun pa byas nas/ dngos bzhi spyod 'jug las 'byung ba'i/ /byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ /sangs rgyas rnams la skyabs su mchi/ /chos dang byang chub sems dpa' yi/ /tshogs la'ang de bzhin skyabs su mchi/ /ji ltar sngon gyi bde gshegs kyis/ /byang chub thugs ni bskyed pa dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la/ /de dag rim gyis gnas pa ltar/ /bdag kyang 'gro la phan don du/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed bgyi zhing / /byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la/ /rim pa bzhin du bslab par bgyi/ /zhes pa lan gsum brjod cing brjod pa tha ma la 'jug sems skyes par bsam mo/ /rjes kyi cho ga la/ rang spro ba bskyed cing sdom pa brtan par bya ba ni/ de nyid nas 'byung ba'i/ deng dus bdag tshe 'bras su yod/ /mi yi srid pa'ang legs par thob/ /de ring sangs rgyas rigs su skyes/ /sangs rgyas sras su da gyur to/ /da ni bdag gis ci nas kyang / /rigs dang mthun pa'i las brtsams te/ /skyon med btsun pa'i rigs 'di la/ /rnyog par mi 'gyur de ltar bya/ /zhes brjod/ gzhan dga' ba bskyed pa ni/ de nyid las/ bdag gi de ring skyob pa thams cad kyi/ /spyan sngar 'gro la bde gshegs nyid dang ni/ /bar du bde la mgron du bos zin gyis/ /lha dang lha min la sogs dga' bar gyis/ /zhes brjod cing de dag gi don yang bsam par bya'o/ /sems bskyed pa'i bslab bya ni gsum ste/ sems de nyid gzhan don du bskyed ba'i rgyu mtshan/ blo la bzhag nas dngos dang brgyud pas ci nus kyi sems can la phan 'dogs pa dang / de'i don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan blo la bzhag nas/

byang chub chen po thob 'dod kyi 'dun pa drag pos rang nyid lam bsgrub pa la brtson pa dang / gnas skabs mthar thug gi phan yon blo la bzhag nas sems de nyid la yang yang goms par byed pa'o/ /de la bla ma gnyan gyi zhal nas/ de lta bu'i bsam sbyor 'jug pa'i byang chub kyi sems snga dro yod na snga dro dang / gung la yod na gung / phyi dro yod na phyi dro/ rtag tu yod na rtag tu byang chub sems dpa' dang sems ma yin/ ye med na rgyal sras kyi ming mi thob gsung ngo / /de lta bu'i spang bya spong ba dang / bslab bya la slob pa la yang thog mar sems nyid 'di bsrung dgos shing / sems bsrung ba la yang / dran pa dang shes bzhin legs par bsten dgos te/ spyod 'jug las/ bslab pa bsrung ba 'dod pa yi/ /rab tu bsgrims nas sems bsrung ste/ /sems de bsrung bar ma byas na/ /bslab pa bsrung bar yong mi nus/ /zhes dang / yang / dge ba gzhan ni nyams sla yi/ /sems ni nam yang nyams mi bya/ /sems bsrung 'dod pa rnams la ni/ /dran pa dang ni shes bzhin dag /thams cad 'bad pas bsrung shig ces/ /bdag ni de ltar thal mo sbyor/ /zhes gsungs pas/ dran shes bzhin bsten pa 'di chos thams cad kyi nyams len gyi rtsa bar gsungs pa yin no/ /de ltar skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang / thun gang yin gyi 'jug tu bdag gis 'di ltar bgyis pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis mtshon te/ dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba rnams kyis mthu nus la brten nas/ myur du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par shog shig snyam pas/ dge ba 'di yis skye bo kun/ /zhes sogs rang gis gang shes bsngo ba smon lam bya zhing / rnam pa kun tu sems ma yengs pa'i dran shes bsten no/ /de dag ni gong dal 'byor rnyed dka'i dmigs rkang nas bzung ste/ dmigs rkang thams cad kyi mgo mjug tu sbyar ro/ /gnyis pa sdig sgrib sbyong bar byed pa yi ge brgya pa'i 'khrid ni/

bla ma gnyan gyis gsungs nas/ zhing tshwa sgo can la lo thog mi skye ba bzhin du/ rgyud sgrib pa dang bcas pa la nyams rtogs mi skye bas/ sdig sgrib sbyang ba'i phyir yi ge brgya pa la 'bad par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs te/ bshad pa'i rnam grangs gzhan du gsal zhing / nyams len dngos ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed kyi rjes de ma thag rang gi spyi bor pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la/ skad cig gis rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas rdo rje thugs kha dang / g.yon rdo rje dril bu dkur brten pa/ zhi zhing sgeg pa'i nyams can/ rin po che'i rgyan dang / dar gyi na bzas mdzes pa/ zhabs g.yas cung zad brkyang zhing / g.yon bskum pa'i phyed krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i thugs khar zla ba'i steng hūm̐ dkar po de las 'od zer 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi snying po ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs nas hūm̐ la thim/ hūm̐ las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs rdo rje sems dpa'i sku gang / zhabs g.yas pa'i mthe bong gi lto nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'dzag bdag gi smin mtshams nas zhugs/ 'khor ba thog ma med pas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung thams cad dag par bsam la/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra sa twa tā+e no pa/ tiṣ+ṭha ḍir+dho me bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bhā wa/ a nu rak+to me bhā wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bhā wa/ sarba sid+dhi me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsit+ta shrī yaṃ ku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha ho bha ga wan sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra mā me muñca/ badz+ri bhā wa ma hā sa ma ya sa twa aḥ zhes pa gtsobor bzla zhing / thun mjug tu/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa hūm̐/ zhes ci nus bzla/ sngags don oṃ ni skad dod gzhan du bsgyur du med kyang bkra shis pa logs pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa yin pas sngags kyi mgo 'dren pa yin no/ /de ltar yang rdo rje rtse mo las/ oṃ ni ji zhig yin par brjod/

/mchog dang nor ster dpal dang g.yang / /skal bzang rnam pa dang ldan shing / /dam bca' ba dang bkra shis don/ /nor bu 'dzin pa'i snying po yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /badz+ra satwa ni rdo rje sems dpa'/ sa ma ya ni dam tshig ma nu ni rjes su/ pā la ni skyong / de ltar na rdo rje sems dpa' dam tshig rjes su skyong / /zhes pa'o/ /de la dam tshig ni sems can sgrol bar dam bcas pa'o/ /badz+ra sa twa twe no pa ni rdo rje sems dpa' nyid kyis/ tiṣ+ṭha ni gnas pa/ ḍi ḍho ni brtan pa/ me ni bdag bha wa ni gyur cig pa ste/ rdo rje sems dpa' nyid kyis gnas pa brtan par gyur cig pa'o/ /su to ṣ+yo ni dges pa shin tu/ me bha wa ni sngar ltar te bdag la shin tu dges par gyur cig pa'o/ /a nu ni rjes su/ rak+to ni chags pa/ me bha wa ni sngar ltar ste/ bdag la rjes su chags par gyur cig pa'o/ /su po ṣ+yo ni rgyas pa shin tu/ me bha wa sngar ltar ste/ bdag la shin tu rgyas par gyur cig pa'o/ /sarba thams cad/ sid+dhi dngos grub/ me bdag la/ pra rab tu/ yañca stsol te/ dngos grub thabs cad bdag la rab tu stsol zhes pa'o/ /sarba sngar ltar/ karma las/ su rtsa yang / me bdag tsit+ta sems/ shri yaṃ bde legs/ ku ru mdzod/ las thams cad yang bdag gi sems bde gshegs su mdzod/ ces pa'o/ /hūm̐ ni thugs kyi sa bon rdor sems kyi ngo bo/ ha bzhi ho dang lnga ni ye shes lnga mtshon byed dang / bha ga wan bcom ldan 'das/ sarba thams cad/ ta thā de bzhin/ ga ta gshegs pa/ badz+ri sngar ltar ste/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje zhes pa'o/ /mā me bdag muñca grol ba/ badz+ri rdo rje/ bha wa ni sngar ltar ste/ nga grol ba'i rdo rje gyur cig pa'o/ /ma hā chen po/ sa ma ya satwa sngar ltar ste/ dam tshig sems dpa' chen po zhes bod pa'o/ /a ni yul gyi ngo bo ste/ sngar gyi hūm̐ dang sbrel pas thabs shes zung 'jug mtshon pa'o/

/yang na a ni ma skyes pa'i don te/ sdig sgrib skye med do/ /'di ni de nyid 'dus pa'i rgyud nas bshad pa'i yi ge brgya pa'o/ /sngags phyi ma'i don ni/ rdo rje sems dpa' bdag zung zhes pa'am/ yang na rdo rje sems dpa' bdag ma btang zhig ces pa 'byung gsungs/ sngags ring thung gnyis ka'i gnad ni gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshul can du yod do/ /grangs ni nyung mtha' nyi shu rtsa gcig nas mang mtha' tshad med do/ /mjug bshags sdom la/ rten gyi stobs ni rdo rje sems dpa'/ sngar byas kyi las rnams 'gyod sems drag pos bshags pa rnam par bsun 'byin pa'i stobs/ phyin chad srog la bab kyang mi bgyid snyam pa gnyen po kun tu spyod pa'i stobs/ de ltar byas pas sdig pa 'dag nges snyam pa ni sor chud pa'i stobs te/ don de rnams yid la dran bzhin pas/ phyag 'tshal bstod de phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /phyag 'tshal 'dud de phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gus pas sku la bdag gsol 'debs/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bdag grub mdzod/ /sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so/ /sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlabs tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ rdo rje sems dpa' 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dang / rdo rje sems dpa'i sku gsung thugs dbyer med du gyur par bsam mo/ /de dag ni 'khrid yig phal che ba nas 'byung ba ltar yin la/ bde kye la sogs pa'i rnal 'byor bla med la 'dris pa dag gis/ he ru ka'i yig brgya bde kye ltar bya ste/ chos rje bla mas de bzhin bshad do/ /'di la brten nas sdig pa dag pa'i rtags rmi lam du lus las rnag khrag 'dzag pa dang / 'khrus pa dang / skyug pa la sogs pa rmi ba dang / dngos su lus yang ba dang / khams bde ba dang / gnyid chung ba dang / rig pa dwang ba la sogs pa 'byung bar 'gyur bas/

de dag ma byung gi bar du bya'o/ /don 'di la dgongs nas/ de nyid 'dus par yi ge brgya pa gsungs pa'i mjug de ma thag tu/ 'dis ni mtshams med pa lnga byas pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bslus pa dang / dam pa'i chos la smod pa dang / nyes pa thams cad byas pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi phyag rgya bsgrub pa po rdo rje sems dpa' brtan par gyur pas/ tshe 'di nyid la ji ltar 'dod pa'i dngos grub thams cad dam/ dngos grub dam pa'am/ rdo rje sems dpa'i dngos grub bam de bzhin gshegs pa'i dngos grub kyi bar du 'thob bo zhes/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje sems dpas gsung so/ /zhes gsung pa lags// ༈ /gsum pa tshogs rdzogs par byed pa maṇ+ḍal gyi 'khrid ni/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud pas/ zhing 'di rin chen bdun rnams kyis/ /mkhas pa dag gis yongs bskangs te/ /dngos grub 'dod pas dngos grub phyir/ /shes rab can gyis nyin bzhin dbul/ /zhes gsungs pas 'di la gang la 'bul ba'i yul gsal btab pa dang / ji ltar 'bul ba'i tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkha' rin po che'i khri yangs shing rgya che ba/ bkod pa phun gsum tshogs pa'i steng du/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la/ skad cig gis drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa rdo rje 'chang chen po sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ rdo rje dang dril bu thugs khar bsnol nas 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje dkyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dpag tu med pas brgyan pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ skyabs yul rnams dang / brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams spyan drangs/ rtsa ba'i bla ma'i mtha' skor du bzhugs/ yang 'od 'phros phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang / dkon mchog gsum thams cad spyan drangs/

gnyis su med par thim/ bla ma de dkon mchog gsum kun 'dus su bsam la/ gang gi drin gyi bde chen nyid/ /skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang / /bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku/ /rdo rje 'chang zhabs pad la 'dud/ /ces pas bstod/ yang na/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bdag nyid/ bla ma dam pas bdag gi rgyud byin gyi brlabs tu gsol/ bsdu na de tsam gyis kyang chog la/ spro na rgyud 'debs dang / mchod yon la sogs pa'i nyer mchod/ rgyal srid sna bdun/ 'dod yon lnga'i mchod pa rnams spyi 'gro ltar dbul bar bya zhing / de nas 'bru gtsang ma dang maṇ+ḍal 'dus byas la/ maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bdun ma gtso bor 'bul skabs skabs su so bdun ma yang 'bul zhing gsol ba gdab/ thun bsdu ba'i tshe/ oṃ āḥ hūm̐ bla ma sangs rgyas rin po che la gsol ba 'debs/ bdag la sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ de'i tshe oṃ zhes pa'i tshe/ bla ma'i dpral ba'i oṃ dkar po las 'od dkar po byung / bdag gi lus kyi dpral bar thim pas lus kyi dri ma dag bla ma'i sku'i byin brlabs zhugs/ āḥzhes pa'i tshe mgrin pa'i āḥdamar po las 'od dmar po byung / bdag gi mgrin par zhugs/ ngag gi dri ma dag gsung gi byin brlabs zhugs/ hūm̐ zhes pa'i tshe/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ sngon po las 'od sngon po byung / bdag gi snying khar thim/ yid kyi dri ma dag thugs kyi byin brlabs zhugs par bsam/ de ltar 'od dkar dmar mthing gsum gyis lus kyi nang thams cad gang / sdig sgrib thams cad dag sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa'i byin brlabs zhugs par bsam/ de nas bla ma la re dogs 'gog pa'i gsol ba btab pas bla ma dges te/ 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas/ bla ma'i sku gsung thugs dang / rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dbyer med du bsam la/ rang gi sems gsal stong gi ngo bo la/ 'das pa'i rjes mi gcod/

ma 'ongs pa'i sngon mi bsu/ da ltar ba'i shes pa bzo bcos mi bya bar/ bya bab la bzhag de yang cung zad sgrim/ de nas blod la/ rang babs su bzhag gsal na 'phro bcad/ mi gsal na 'phro bcad/ dug dbyung / yang lan cig bsgom pa la/ lta ba bskyang ngo / maṇ+ḍal gyi phan yon ni/ ba'i lci ba chur bcas sbyin pa ste/ /legs par nyugs par byed pa tshul khrims so/ /srid dang grog sbur bsal ba bzod pa yin/ /bya ba la ni nyer zhugs brtson 'grus te/ /de la skad cig sems ni mi mthong ba/ /bsam gtan shes rab ri mo gsal ba yi/ /thub pa'i maṇ+ḍal byas pa yis/ /pha rol phyin pa 'di drug thob/ /ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /bzhi pa byin rlabs myur du 'jug par byed pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid ni/ tshe 'di'i bde skyid dang mchog thun mong gi dngos grub 'grub dgos pas/ rgyud la byin rlabs 'jug cing / zhugs pa mi nyams shing 'phel bar byed pa la/ bla ma la mos gus byed dgos la/ de yang mos gus che na byin rlabs che/ 'bring na 'bring / tha ma la tha ma las mi 'byung bas/ sangs rgyas kyis 'du shes bskyed na sangs rgyas kyi byin rlabs 'byung bas na gsol ba 'debs yul gyi bla ma ni rang gi mthong tshul ji ltar mthong yang sangs rgyas dang dbyer med du thag bcad dgos te/ ba tshwa chu klung gi mdo dang / a ti bkod pa'i rgyud las/ lnga brgya tha mar gyur pa'i tshe/ /nga nyid slob dpon gzugs kyis gnas/ /nga yin snyam du yid byos la/ /de tshe de la gus pa bskyed/ /ces sogs mdo rgyud bstan bcos thams cad nas bsam gyis mi khyab pa gsungs so/ /bsgom tshul gyi rim pa ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar sogs nas/ lta ba bskyang ba'i bar maṇ+ḍal dang mchod pa rnams bzhag nas gong ltar nyams su blang ngo / /maṇ+ḍal dang bla ma'i rnal 'byor 'di dag nyams su blang ba la brten nas/ sngar med pa'i mos gus skye ba sogs dang / rmi lam du khri mthon po 'dug pa sogs rtags ma thon gyi bar du 'bad do/

/sngon 'gro 'di dag rgyud la ma skyes na/ chu lud drod gsher sogs dang bral ba'i zhing la sa bon btab pa dang 'dra'o// ༈ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ bskyed rim/ rdzogs rim/ zung 'brel phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa'o/ /de dag gi rnam bzhag bla med spyi ltar nges par bya zhing / nyams len gyi rim pa la/ las dang po pas mngon byang lnga la rten pa'i bskyed rim rgyas pa dang / sems cung zad brtan pas dkrong skyed sogs kyang rung ngo / /'di'i mngon byang gzhan dang cung zad mi 'dra ste/ de yang 'di ltar swa bhā wa'i sngags brjod de/ rang nyid pad+ma'i sdong po'i steng na gnas pa'i rang gi snying khong stong du bsgom pa ni mngon byang dang po stong pa nyid las byang chub pa'o/ /de'i ngang las pad+ma 'dab brgyad dang / de'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsgom pa ni/ gnyis pa gdan pad zla las byung ba'o/ /zla ba'i steng du hrīḥbasgom pa ni/ gsum pa gsung yig 'bru las byang chub pa'o/ /hrīḥlas 'od 'phros te/ rang gi lus kyi nang thams cad khengs pas/ tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad dag sngon gyi las kyi rnam smin las grub pa'i sha khrag rus pa la sogs pa ma dag pa'i lus kyi phung po de dag 'od kyi gong bur gyur/ de zhu ba las byung ba'i pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa 'od kyi rang bzhin can du gyur par bsgom pa ni thugs phyag mtshan las byang chub pa'o/ /pad zla phyag mtshan thams cad 'od kyi gong bur gyur/ yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid yi dam thugs rje chen po/ sku mdog ston ka'i zla ba ltar dkar ba/ zhal 'dzum bag dang ldan pa dbu skra phyed thor cog tu byas shing / phyed sil bur 'phyang ba/ phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas kyi gnyis pa shel phreng / g.yon gyi gnyis pa na pad+ma dkar po/ snyan gyi thad kar kha bye ba bsnams pa/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan/

mgul rgyan/ dpung rgyan/ phyag gdub/ zhabs gdub/ se mo do/ ska rags la sogs pa/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyi brgyan pa/ dar dkar po'i stod g.yogs dang / dar sna tshogs kyis sham thabs can/ rdo rje dkyil krung du bzhugs pa/ ri dwags kriṣ+ṇa sa ri'i rgyab yol can/ snang la rang bzhin med pa'i skur bsgom pa ni/ sku yongs su rdzogs pa las byang chub pa'o/ /de nas rang gi thugs kha'i pad zla'i steng du yi ge hīḥdakar po gcig bsgom ste/ de las 'od 'phros phyi snod kyi 'jig rten thams cad la phog pas/ ma dag pa'i dri ma thams cad bkrus 'od du zhu/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ rin po che sna bdun las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang grub bzhi sgo bzhi/ rta babs dang bcas pa/ phyi nas bltas na nang gsal ba/ nang nas bltas na phyi gsal ba/ rkang pa stegs na spar byed pa/ mnan na nem byed pa/ de lta bur gyur par bsgom ste/ de bla ma gnyan gyi zhal nas 'o skol gsang sngags pa'i lugs kyis/ gnas gang du 'dug kyang gzhal yas khang bya ba yin te/ 'di lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas na/ 'dug pa sa phug brag phug la sogs par 'dug kyang / gzhal yas khang du bsgoms pas nam zhig sangs rgyas nas zhing khams rnam par dag pa'i rgyu yin gsung / yang 'od 'phros rang gi lus kyi phyi nang gi srin bu nas brtsams te bcud kyi sems can thams cad la phog pas sdig sgrib thams cad dag nas/ tha na lus kyi ba spu'i bu gar thams cad kyang thugs chen po'i skur gyur par bsgom mo/ /de la bla ma gnyan gyi zhal nas/ gsang sngags pa'i lugs la/ grogs su dang 'grogs yang yi dam lha zhes pa yin te/ 'di lta bu'i rnal 'byor la gnas nas/ tha na dud 'gro dang 'grogs kyang yi dam lhar bsgoms pas/ nam zhig sangs rgyas nas 'khor yongs su dag pa'i rgyu yin gsung / yang hrīḥlas 'od 'phros/ yi dam gyi lha dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ dzā hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ

zhes brjod pas rdo tshan la kha ba 'bab pa bzhin rang la gnyis su med par thim pas thams cad kyang ma 'dres par til gyi gang bu bzhin gnas par bsam pa ni/ rang yi dam kun 'dus pa'i bdag nyid du bsam/ de la gnyan gyi zhal nas/ tshe 'di la grub pa thob par byed pa la 'di lta bu'i blo stobs gcig dgos pa yin te/ yi dam gyi lha gcig la yi dam thams cad 'dus par bsgoms pas/ yi dam gyi lha thams cad kyi zhal myur du mthong zhing / dngos grub 'byung ba yin gyi/ 'ga' zhig lha yang bsgoms yang bshig mang po byed par 'dug ste/ de la zhal mthong dus yang mi yong la/ dngos grub yang mi 'byung ste/ yi dam gyi lha la 'dor len du song ba yin gsungs/ khong rang sku gshegs khar yi dam gyi lha mang po'i zhal gzigs skad/ yang hrīḥlas 'od 'phros rang gi tshangs bug nas thon te/ rtsa ba'i bla ma gang bzhugs nas spyan drangs/ sku 'das nas mi bzhugs na 'og min nas spyan drangs/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs te/ bum pa'i chus rang la dbang bskur/ chu rgyun gyis lus thams cad gang / sdig sgrib thams cad dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las spyi bo'i gtsug tu nyi zla pad+ma dang dar gyi lhab klub gyi gdan gyi steng du/ rtsa ba'i bla ma nyid rigs kyi bdag po 'od dpag med byams pa khyil bzhugs kyis bzhugs par bsam/ de nas bla ma'i thugs kha dang / rang gi snying ga'i hrīḥlas 'od 'phros pas brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dang / rang la chos 'brel yod tshad kyi bla ma rnams spyan drangs te rtsa ba'i bla ma la gnyis su med par bstim pas/ bla ma kun 'dus su bsam/ 'di la chos rje kun spangs kyi zhal nas/ res 'ga' rang gang mi mos pa de spyi bor bsgom la/ de la mos pa'i bla ma thams cad bstim/ res 'ga' gang mos pa de spyi bor bsgoms la/ mi mos pa thams cad bstim la/ bla ma thams cad la mnyam nyid du mos gus bya'o gsungs/ gnyan gyi zhal nas/

tshe 'di la grub pa thob pa la/ 'di lta bu'i blo stobs gcig dgos te/ bla ma gcig la bla ma thams cad 'dus par bsgoms nas mos gus byas pas byin rlabs myur du 'byung ba yin gyi/ 'ga' zhig gis bla ma yang bsgom yang bshig mang po byed pa 'dug ste/ bla ma la 'dor len byed pa la byin rlabs mi 'byung gsungs/ de nas rang gi snying khar pad zla'i steng du hrīḥdakar po la yi ge drug gis bskor ba la klog pa'i tshul du bsam la sngags bzlas pa'o/ /de yang rang rkyang par ma zad/ spyi bo'i bla ma kun 'dus pa dang / yi dam kun 'dus dang / mkha' mnyam sems can lhar bsgom pa dang / tha na lus kyi srin bu lhar bsgom pa yan chad kyis bzlas pa'i grogs byed par bsam la bzla'o/ /de'ang brjod pa dngos snying kha'i hrīḥl ma ṇi'i bskor bar byed/ gnyis pas gsal btab/ gsum pa phan chod kyis sgra grags stong rang bzhin med par bsam la bzlas so/ /de la gnyan gyi zhal nas/ da lta phal cher sngags rdog po gcig bgrang phreng ba rdog po gcig bskyur nas bzlas pa byed de/ de lta bus bsnyen pa 'khyol dus mi yong / tshe gcig la sangs rgyas thob par byed pa la/ 'di lta'i bzlas pa byed pa ni/ dpag tu med pa'i tshad med par 'gyur ba'i bzlas pa yin gsungs/ khong rang phreng ba hab kyur mdzad cing / 'di lta bu'i steng nas thugs dam mdzad lags skad/ kun spangs chos rje'i zhal nas kyang / sems kyis zin par gyur na 'di lta bu bgrang ba la'ang phan yon dpag tu med pa 'byung gsung ngo / /gnyis pa goms pas skad cig dran rdzogs su bsgom pa ni/ de lta bu'i bskyed rim la brtan pa thob nas/ skad cig la mngon byang lngas lha gsal gdab pa nas brtsams te/ bzlas pa'i bar du yid ma yengs par rtse gcig pa'i rnal 'byor nyams su len pa'o/ /de yang gong gi mngon byang gi don de rnams yid kyis bsams nas ngag 'don/ chos dbyings mtha' bral chen po'i ngang nyid la sogs rje dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs tshigs bcad ma gzhir bzhag nas/

kun 'dus rnam gnyis dang / bzlas pa'i skabs su 'od zer spro bsdu byas pas don 'grub bo/ /gsum pa khyer so gsum gyis mjug bsdu ba ni/ de lta snod gzhal yas khang dang / bcud lha'i rang bzhin du snang la rang bzhin med par shes pa ni/ snang ba sku'i khyer so yin la/ sgra grags pa thams cad snying po'i sngags kyi rang bzhin sgra grags stong du shes pa ni/ grags pa gsung gi khyer so yin zhing / sems kyis dran rig rtog pa ci byung thams cad rig stong lha'i thugs kyi rang bzhin du shes pa ni/ dran pa thugs kyi khyer so yin no/ /de lta bu'i khyer so gsum dang ma bral bzhin/ mnyam rjes thams cad la rgyal btab nas bsgom pa nyid gnad du che'o/ /sems zin pa'i rtags ni/ rab la lha'i phyag mang pos dngos su don byed nus pa dang / 'bring la gzhan gyis kyang ltar snang ba dang tha ma rnam rtog spong ba'o/ /bogs dbyung ba ni/ de ltar bsgoms pas/ las dang po pas lha sku la sems ma zin na/ dang po lha'i sa bon rkyang pa la sems bzung / de la zin nas gtso bo rkyang pa la/ de la zin nas spyi bo'i bla ma la/ de zin nas bcud lhar gyur pa thams cad dang / gzhal yas khang gi bar la rim pas bslab cing / lha'i sku yang thog mar rags pa dang / phra ba dang / phra ba'i bar la rim pas sems 'dzin pa la bslab par bya'o/ /de nyid la lam 'bras kyi chos thams cad tshang bar ngo sprad pa ni/ kun rdzob tu lha sku sgyu ma lta bu/ don dam par chos sku'i rang bzhin du bsgoms pas/ bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug dang bden gnyis kyang tshang zhing / dngos po la lha'i rnam pa ni mi gnas kyang / blos btags nas bsgoms pas kun btags de ltar btags nas bsgoms pas/ myang 'das kyi lam du 'gro bas gzhan dbang / gang gi ngo bor yang grub pa med par bsgoms pas yongs grub/ de nyid gnas skabs mthar thug gi gnod pa las skyob pas skyabs 'gro/ don des sems nyid spros pa dang bral bar byed pas sangs rgyas rjes dran/

de yang sgyu ma lta bur bsgoms pas/ chos thams cad rten du gyur pas chos rjes su dran pa/ lha'i 'khor la dmigs pa gtad nas lha rjes su dran pa'o/ /bsod nams kyi tshogs bsog pas tshogs lam/ swa bhā was sems tsam du shes pa sbyor lam/ shu n+ya tas stong pa nyid du shes pas mthong lam/ rten gzhal yas khang dang bcas pa bskyed nas bsgoms pas sgom lam/ 'khor lo bsdus nas mi dmigs pa mthar phyin pa'i lam mo/ /rang rgyud la lha sku rang chas su yod pa rgyu dus/ lam dus su lha rang ngo sprad nas sgom pa thabs rgyud/ de mngon du gyur pa 'bras bu'i rgyud do/ /tshogs bsog pa dang / go bsgo ba dang / spro bsdu la sogs thams cad sprul sku/ lha zhen pa dang bral ba la dmigs pa gtad pa longs sku/ de'ang rang bzhin med pa chos sku'o/ /des na dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mngon par rtogs pa re re la brten nas sangs rgyas pa'o/ /de'i phyir na gdul bya'i bsam pa dang bstun nas lha'i 'khor lo mang du gsungs kyang / rgyud sde gnyis kyi bskyed rim gang yang rung ba gcig bsgoms pas thams cad bsgom par 'gyur bar shes par bya'o/ /bskyed rim gyi skabs 'dir sbyang gzhi sbyong byed dang / rnam dag cung zad smos na sngon 'gro rnams kyis 'khor ba'i rgyu las nyon sbyong / ye shes tshogs bsags stong pa nyid la byang chub pas 'chi srid sbyong / pad zlas pha ma dang gnas kyi rnam rtog sbyong / hrīḥtsheg drag can gyis pha ma'i thig le dkar dmar las byung ba'i bar srid sbyong / hrīḥlas pad+mar bsgom tshe nur nur po sogs mngal chags nas zla gcig bar du rtsa 'chags/ de nas zhag re la rtsa gnyis brgya nyis brgya chags/ zla ba gsum la stong phrag bdun bcu sogs chags shing / lus rdzogs nas da lta'i bar gyi gnas skabs rnams mngon par rtogs pa'i dngos gzhis sbyong / rgyas par bla med spyi ltar ro/

/rnam dag ni/ sku mdog dkar po ni dbyings rang bzhin gyi rnam par dag pa la/ glo bur rtog 'dzin gyis kyang ma gos pa'o/ /zhal gcig pa ni chos sku de bzhin nyid du ro gcig pa'o/ /phyag bzhi ni tshad med pa bzhi/ de yang dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba ni/ thabs shes gnyis med kyi chos nyid thugs su chud pa/ g.yas kyi gnyis pas shel phreng bsnams pa ni/ sems can rnams 'khor ba nas byang chub tu 'dren pa/ g.yon gyi gnyis pas pad+ma bsnams pa ni pad+ma 'dam las skyes kyang 'dam gyis ma gos pa ltar/ 'khor ba na sems can kyi don mdzad kyang 'khor skyon gyis ma gos pa/ zhabs gnyis rdo rje dkyil krung gis bzhugs pa ni/ dbyings dang ye shes gnyis su med pa'i don la mi g.yo ba'i sems can gyi don la brtan par bzhugs pa/ zhal 'dzum pa'i mdangs ldan pa ni/ sems can gyi don la dgongs shing gdul bya tshim par byed pa'i chos sgra sgrog pa/ spyan zhi ba'i nyams dang ldan pa ni/ sems can rnams la khro ba nye bar zhi ba'i thugs rjes gzigs pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang na bzas spras pa ni/ 'dod pa'i yon tan ma spangs rang sar dag cing / dgos 'dod phun sum tshogs pa thams cad 'byung ba'i don du shes par bya'o/ /phan yon ni/ gnas skabs su lha'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa'i ming dang / brda dang / tha snyad la brten nas/ rang gi sems kyi nyer len gyi rgyu dang / cho gas rkyen byas nas rang gi sems nyid lha'i rnam par snang zhing / de la rnal 'byor pa'i sems gnas par byed pa dang / de la goms pas/ snang srid thams cad rten dang brten pa sgyu ma lta bu'i rang bzhin du shes nas/ rgyud la zhe sdang mi skye zhing / mi snang ba dang / mang po gcig dang / gcig mang por sprul pa la sogs pa lus kyi rdzu 'phrul cung zad ston par nus la/ sgo gsum lha sngags mi rtog pa'i rang bzhin yin pa la yin par shes nas/ ye shes rgyud la bskyed cing /

des sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs rang gi lus ngag yid gsum la mngon du byas nas bsgom pas/ sgro 'dogs nang nas chod pa zhes bya zhing sa brgyad pa mngon du byed cing mthar thug gzugs sku 'grub bo/ /bskyed rim gyi sems 'dzin ni man ngag ltar ro/ /gnyis pa rdzogs rim la/ rnam gzhag spyi ltar dang / nyams len dngos la/ rang thugs rje chen por gsal ba'i lte ba nas spyi gtsug gi bar du rtsa dbu ma phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ de'i g.yas su ro ma dmar po/ g.yon du rkyang ma dkar po gsal btab la rlung ro lan gsum dal gyis bus la/ de nas sna g.yas g.yon gang nas rgyu ngos bzung nas/ de'i rgyun phyir 'gro ba oṃ dkar po nang du 'jug pa āḥdamar po nang du gnas pa hūm̐ sngon po dran par byas la/ rlung so so'i kha dog dang tshad la sogs pa gsal bar mthong gi bar du bsgom na/ las bzhi 'grub pa la sogs pa'i phan yon rnams 'byung ngo / /phra ba ni rags pa'i rdor bzlas mthar phyin nas sngar gyi rgyun de nyid la yig 'bru gsum dmigs pa dor nas/ phyir rgyu ba dang 'od zer dkar po'i rnam pa/ nang du 'jug pa 'od dmar po gnas pa 'od sngon po bsgom la mthar phyin gyi bar du bslab bo/ /de mthar phyin nas rlung kha dog gsum yang spangs nas sgra tsam la dmigs te bsgoms pas gsal la rtog med kyis ye shes skye ba sogs pa'i yon tan dpag tu med pa 'byung ngo // ༈ /gsum pa bskyed rdzogs zung 'brel phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes la goms par bya ba ni/ gong gi bskyed rdzogs de dag gis skyes na don 'grub kyang / 'dir las dang po pa la nyams su blang bde ba'i phyir de kho na nyid bsgom tshul cung zad brjod na/ zhi gnas dang lhag mthong gnyis las/ dang po zhi gnas kyi ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa la/ tshul khrims dag pa/ 'jig rten gyi bya brel med pa gnas dben pa/ gdams ngag gi sgro 'dogs chod pa sogs yan lag tshang ba zhig te/

jo bo rjes/ zhi gnas 'grub pa ma yin pas/ /mngon shes 'byung bar mi 'gyur la/ /de phyir zhi gnas bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /yang dang yang du 'bad par bya/ /zhi gnas yan lag rnams nyams na/ /rab tu 'bad de bsgom byas kyang / /lo ni stong phrag dag gis kyang / /ting 'dzin 'grub par mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs/ de yang mi g.yo ba bzhi ldan dgos te/ lus mi g.yo ba ni/ rkang pa skyil krung / lag pa mnyam bzhag ste rlung dbu mar 'jug pa'i phyag rgya'am/ sa gnon gang bde/ sgal tshigs bsrangs/ rgya mtsho ri rab la sbyor/ ro 'dzin rang gnas su 'phang / mgrin pa cung zad rgu bar bya/ mig mtho gang tsam gyi mdun gyi nam mkha' la blta zhing / bya byed thams cad dang bral bar rang lugs su 'jog pa'o/ /mig mi g.yo ba ni mig mi 'gul ba ste/ 'gul na mig la rnam rtog gi rtsa yod pas rnam rtog sna tshogs 'byung ngo / /mig gi rdzi ma mi 'khrab par bya zhing mchi ma dang zug rngu byung na de la sems ma shor bar bya/ dmigs rten la bslab na/ dmigs rten mi g.yo ba ni/ nye ring 'tshams par dmigs rten sku gzugs sogs sam/ 'di sngar gyi bskyed rim brtan pa'i grogs su yang 'gyur bas/ sngar gyi mig gi lta stangs dang mthun pa'i mdun du rang gis bsgom pa lta bu'i thugs rje chen po'i sku cig drang por bzhag de la mig dang shes pa gnyis ka lhan gtad/ sku de'i cha shas phra ba la yang mi dpyod/ rnam par rags pa las kyang gzhan du yongs su mi gzhug de'i ngang nas sems rang lugs su lhod de bzhag yang na mig la mi gnod pa'i ched du me tog sngon po'am/ ras dar sdon po sogs kyi dmigs rten mi g.yo bar 'jog pa'o/ /yang na ston pa'i sku gser gyi mdog can mdun du bzhugs par bsams kyang rung gsungs/ yang na rten med rang babs su bzhag kyang rung gsung ngo / /de ltar bca' gzhi rnams grub nas/ skyabs 'gro nas bzlas pa'i bar shar bsgom du nyams su blangs la/

sems dmigs rten gyi steng du khrims kyis bsgrim/ de nas lhod kyis bslod/ de gnyis res 'jog tu byas pas sems rtse gcig tu gnas pa mar me rlung gis ma bskyod pa lta bu ma byung bar du bslab/ de la dang por sems mi gnas pa'i steng du sngar las tshab tshub mang du song ba snyam byed pa byung na skyon du mi blta/ nyams dang po ri gzar gyi 'bab chu lta bu zhes bya ste/ rnam rtog ngo shes kyi nyams yin/ de la sogs pa nyams kyi skye tshul rnams bla mas rim par ngo sprad de/ sems tshul min yid byed kyi dbang du mi 'gro ba'i/ sems rtse gcig pa'i ting nge 'dzin ma thob kyi bar du bslab bo// ༈ /lhag mthong la/ bla ma gnyan gyi gsung thad so ni/ 'di lta ste/ gzhi ma bcos pa gnyug ma'i lta ba/ lam spro bsdu med pa zhi lhag zung 'brel gyi sgom pa/ glod pa rang grol gyi bsam gtan ma yengs pa dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyi man ngag dang bzhi yin gsungs te/ 'di la don tshan dang po'i gzhi zhes pa'i don ni/ gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi gzhi ste/ 'og gi lam zhes pa gzhi lam 'bras gsum lam yin dgos pa bzhin no/ /ma bcos pa ni gzhan du ma bcos pa ste/ de ltar na gzhi dran snang sna tshogs pa 'di gang shar las/ gzhan stong pa la sogs par ma bcos pa ste/ stong pa la sogs par bcos pa ni/ slob dpon ār+ya de bas/ skye med ces dang stong zhes dang / /bdag med ces pa'i stong pa nyid/ /dman pa'i bdag nyid gang bsgom pa/ /de dag 'dir ni bdag sgom pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ gnyug ma gnas lugs kyi don dang mi mthun pas so/ /des na lhag mthong gi don ni/ sems nyid gnyug ma rang bzhin gyis spros dang bral ba sgro 'dogs chod cing / blos byas tshig gi brjod pa tsam ma yin pa gnas lugs skye med kyi ngo bo lhag gis mthong zhing / brjod bral du 'jog pa tsam/ kun rdzob tu shes bya'i spu ris ma 'dres pa 'byed pa'i shes rab dang ldan pa'o/

/de bsgom pa la gsum ste/ yul snang sems su sgrub pa/ sems snang sgyu mar sgrub pa/ sgyu ma rten 'brel du bsgrub pa'o/ /dang po ni/ phyi nang snod bcud 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa 'di thams cad byed pa po gzhan med par/ rang gi sems kyis cho 'phrul du thag bcad de/ de ltar yang / sa bcu pa'i mdo las/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag khams gsum po 'di ni sems tsam mo/ /zhes dang / rdo rje gur las/ rin chen sems las phyir gyur pa'i/ /sangs rgyas med cing sems can med/ /gnas pa'i don dang rnam shes dag /phyi rol gyur pa cung zad med/ /ces dang / phyag rgya chen po thig le'i rgyud las/ 'gro dang mi 'gro gang zhig ni/ /de ni thams cad sems yin no/ /zhes dang / don dam bsnyen pa las/ ma skyes pa dang ma 'gags pa'i/ /shes bya gang gi 'di mthong ba/ /de ni rang sems gzhan ma yin/ /zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /zhes ngo sprad par bya'o/ /da gnyis pa spros te bshad pa la/ nang sems kyis dbang gis dngos po gcig nyid snang ba sna tshogs su 'char ba'i tshul bshad pa dang / sems gcig nyid snang ba sna tshogs su 'char ba'i rgyu mtshan bstan pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ mi'i 'gro ba la chu zhes yongs su grags pa'i chos 'di la/ 'gro ba rigs drug gis dus gcig tu bltas pa na/ lha'i 'gro ba la bdud rtsi/ de bzhin du lha ma yin la go mtshon/ mi la chu/ dud 'gro la gnas/ yi dwags la rnag khrag dmyal ba la khro chu khol mar snang bas kyang / snang ba 'di sems nyid rang snang ba yin te/ theg bsdus las/ dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro dang / /lha rnams ji ltar ris ris su/ /dngos gcig yid ni tha dad phyir/ /don ma grub par 'dod pa yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /yang dmyal ba'i lcags bsregs kyi sa gzhi dang / de na 'bar ba'i me'i phung po la byed pa po'i skyes bu gzhan med pas kyang snang ba 'di sems nyid rang snang yin te/ slon dpon zhi ba lhas/

lcags bsregs sa gzhi su yis byas/ /me tshogs de dag ci las byung / /de 'dra de dag thams cad ni/ /sdig sems yin par thub pas gsungs/ /zhes gsungs so/ /yang rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi longs sku'i zhing rgya yongs su ma chad pa bzhin du/ sems can rnams kyi sems yongs su dag ma dag ci rigs pa'i dbang gis/ khams gsum na rigs drug gi gnas bzang ngan tha dad par snang bas kyang / snang ba 'di thams cad sems nyid rang snang ba yin te/ dri ma med par grags pa'i bstan pa'i mdo las/ shā ri'i bu sangs rgyas kyi zhing gcig tu skyes kyang / sems can rnams kyi sems ji ltar yongs su dag pa bzhin du/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi zhing gi yon tan bkod pa mthong ngo / /zhes gsungs/ de ltar snang ba sems su thag bcad nas/ gnas pa dang / 'gyu bas bsdus pa'i sems 'di la rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i cha ci 'dra zhig 'dug ces/ 'a le 'o le ma yin par dpyad par zhu byas te slob ma rnams brtag dpyad byar gzhug de yang skyabs 'gro nas zhi gnas kyi bar nyams su blangs nas/ sngar bshad pa ltar chos thams cad rang gi sems su 'dug cing / sems de'i gnas lugs ji lta bu zhig yin snyam du bsam zhing 'tshol ba'o/ /de yang gzhan gyi rjes zlos dang / tshig skam gyis go ba tsam ma yin par slob ma re re nas zur du bkar la thag bcad dgos so/ /de yang la la sngar gyi zhi gnas rang yin pa mi 'dug zer ba dang / la la ci yang med pa'i stong pa gcig 'dug zer ba dang / la la ngos bzung 'di yin rang med pa'i sa le sing nge ba cig 'dug zer ba 'ong ste/ de tsam gyis kyang tshod mi bzung bar bag tsam mgo bskor zhing dri/ de ltar yang yang nyams lta byas nas gnas pa las mi 'dug zer na da dung gsol ba 'debs shing man+ḍal phul la/ gnas pa'i ngo bo de ka ci 'dra zhig 'dug thag chod par ltos shig byas la zhag 'ga' sgom du gzhug ci yang med pa'i stong pa zhig 'dug zer na/

'o na khyed la sems gtan med na khyed rang sa rdo sogs dang khyad med du song bas ma bzang / 'on kyang da dung stong pa de'i ngang las gsal rig sogs kyi rnam pa ci 'dug ka'ang ltos dang / ci yang med par shes mkhan de su yin par 'dug legs par ltos shig byas la zhag 'ga' sgom du gzhug de ltar byas pas lta tshul de gnyis gang gis kyang ngo mthong ba shas che/ de ltar byas kyang ngo ma mthong na slar yang bsag sbyang gi rnal 'byor gyi dmigs pa rnams bskyar nas 'jur la btab par bya'o/ /sngar gyi zhi gnas kyi skabs dang mi 'dra bar/ gnas pa'i dus kyi sems de la bde gsal mi rtog pa la sogs pa'i ngos bzung med bzhin du/ rjen ne/ lhang nge ba'i rnam pa ji bzhin bshad du mi btub pa cig 'dug zer na ngo mthong ba yin no/ /de nas gnyis pa 'gyu ba'i rnam rtog la sgro 'dogs dpyod pa'i tshul ni/ lus gnad nas bla ma la gsol ba 'debs pa'i bar sngar ltar la/ khyad par bdag gi 'gyu ba'i sems kyi bzhugs tshul rtogs par byin gyis brlabs tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ de nas rang gi sems rang lugs su lhod bzhag go /de nas lhag gnas pa na gnas pa de'i ngo bo la cher ba gcig ltos de yang rtog pa gcig rang 'gyus su 'gyur pa'am/ ched du gtad nas 'gyur bcug la de'i ngo bo la cer ba gcig ltos/ de gnyis ngo bo la khyad par 'dug gam mi 'dug 'dug na ci 'dra zhig 'dug yang yang du thag chod par ltos/ skabs su gsol ba dung dung pa thob la ltos/ de ltar byas pas gnas pa dang 'gyu ba la khyad par mi 'dug de gnyis ka'i ngo bo gsal stong du 'dug zer na/ 'o na rtog pa de yal ba'i rjes la gsal stong du 'ong gi 'dug gam/ rtog pa tol le ba de ka gsal stong du 'dug dang po ltar 'dug zer na ngo ma mthong ba yin pas/ khyed rang rtog pa gcig skyes gnyis skyes ji tsam skyes kyang dgag don med pas/

gang skye skye skye ru chug ngo ma shes pa la yang ma shor bar/ gcig skyes ngos bzung / gnyis skyes ngos bzung / yang res 'ga' rtog pa la bzo ma byed par kho rang gi steng du lhod de gzhog res 'ga' nga'i sems zer ba'i gsal gsal rig rig po 'di la ngos bzung rang ci 'dra zhig 'dug gzhi rtsa rang ci 'dra zhig 'dug bden pa'i cha rang ci 'dra zhig 'dug legs par thag chod/ de yang yun ring du mi lta/ yud tsam yud tsam du ltos/ zhes sogs slob ma'i nyams dang sbyar zhing dmigs pa'i mde kha bsgyur bas/ rtog pa to le ba 'di ka 'gyu bzhin du ngos bzung med/ ngos bzung med bzhin du 'gyu bas gsal stong du gda' zer na ngo mthong ba yin no// ༈ /da gnyis pa ngo sprad pa la/ nang gi sems spyir ngo sprad pa dang / khyad par rnam rtog ngo sprad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ sems 'di khyad par gsum dang ldan par ngo sprad pa dang / khyad par gsum ldan gyi sems sangs rgyas su ngo sprad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'dir re zhig sems 'di la ldog cha gsum du dbye bar bya ste/ stong pa sems kyi rang bzhin/ gsal ba sems kyi mtshan nyid/ zung 'jug sems kyi ngo bo gsum du 'byed/ de la dang po ni/ nang 'dzin pa'i sems la sems mnyam par 'jog tshul dang / de ltar bzhag pa la shes rab kyi dbang pos dpyod tshul sngar bshad pa ltar byas pa na/ sems 'di yod med la sogs pa gang du yang ngos bzung du med cing / 'di dang 'di zhes bya ba'i ming gdags su ma btub pa/ blo'i yul las 'das pa lta bu cig 'dug pa de la stong pa sems kyi rang bzhin zer ba lags/ de lta bu'i stong pa de ni gnas pa dang 'gyu ba las sogs pa'i/ gzugs dang sgra la sogs pa'i dran snang thams cad la khyab byed du zhugs pas chos gang la yang 'di la khyab 'di la ma khyab med do/ /stong pa'i don yang yod med dam 'khor 'das la sogs pa nas/ tha na stong pa tsam du yang ma grub ste/

chos kyi phyag rgya'i mdo las/ bcom ldan 'das stong pa nyid ces bya ba'i tshig don gang lags/ bka' bstsal pa/ shā ri'i bu stong pa nyid ces bya ba ni gdags su med pa'o/ /zhes dang / go cha bkod pa'i mdo las/ stong pa nyid la stong pa nyid du mi lta'o/ /stong pa nyid las logs shig tu yang stong pa nyid du mi lta'o/ /zhes dang / phyir mi ldog pa 'khor lo'i mdo las/ brjod pa thams cad chad pa ni/ /stong pa nyid ces rab tu brtan/ /zhes gsungs te/ tshul 'di snga phyi thams cad du dran par bya'o/ /gsal ba dang zung 'jug gnyis ni/ sems gnas 'gyu la sogs pa bye brag so so'i dbang gis cung zad mi 'dra ste/ de la dang po gnas pa'i dbang du byas na/ sngar gyi rang bzhin stong pa de'i ngang nas gsal sing nge ba'am/ rjen ne yer re ba'i rnam par gsal bar gnas pa de'i mtshan nyid yin pas/ de la gsal ba sems kyi mtshan nyid zer/ stong gsal gnyis po de gnas pa gcig gi ngo bor dbyer med pa de la zung 'jug sems kyi ngo bo zer ba yin no/ /gnyis pa 'gyus pa'i dbang du byas na/ sngar gyi stong pa de'i rang nas dad mos sam/ chags sdang la sogs pa dungs dungs lam lam/ dur dur greng greng ba de 'gyus pa de dang de'i mtshan nyid yin pas/ de la gsal ba sems kyi mtshan nyid zer/ sngar gyi stong pa ci yang ma grub pa de dang / 'gyus pa'i shes pa bkra hra mi ba de gnyis so so ma yin pa tha mi dad pa de la zung 'jug sems kyi ngo bo zer ba yin no/ /des na de ltar ngo sprad pa de khyed rang gi myong ba dang / e mthun par 'dug ces ngo sprad par bya'o/ /sems kyi gnas lugs de ltar yin na/ 'khor 'das kyi snang ba sna tshogs pa 'di ji ltar yin zhe na/ de la sgyu ma dang rten 'brel du sgrub pa gnyis brjod bral du nges shes bskyed pa ste/ de yang phyi rol gyi snang ba sna tshogs pa 'di dag byed pa po gzhan gyis byas pa ma yin gyis/

rang gi sems la bag chags sna tshogs pas de ltar snang ba yin/ rmi lam gyi snang ba dang khyad par med do/ /zhes thag bcad de/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po shrī dza ga ta mi tra'i zhal nas/ thog ma bar dang mthar rim bzhin/ /rtsa ba ngo bo byed bral ba/ /rmi lam gyis ni mar me bzhin/ /zhes dang / mnyam sbyor las/ e ma sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang / /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas skye ba med/ /skye ba med pas thams cad skyes/ /skyes tsam nyid nas skye ba med/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ sems nyid 'di dang po gang nas byung / bar du gang na gnas/ tha ma gang du 'gro brtag pas/ dper na sgyu ma'i rta glang 'dra bar/ dang po gang nas kyang ma skyes shing / rgyu rkyen gang gis kyang ma skyes pa ye stong rtsa bral gcig tu 'dug par rang gi ngo bo mo gsham gyi bu ltar bden pa med/ dbyibs dang kha dog tu ma grub pas 'gyus pa stong 'gyus/ snang ba stong snang du 'dug mthar 'gag pa med cing / byed pa thams cad dang bral te/ 'gyus pa rang gcig tu 'dug de gnyis ka rnam thar sgo gsum gyi ngo bo yang yin te/ shrī dzā ga ta mi tras/ 'gro 'ong gnas ni skye 'gag dag /rnam rtog stong pa nyid rnam gsum/ /zhes pa ltar/ dang po skye ba med pa rnam par thar pa'i sgo mtshan ma med pa/ bar du gnas pa med pa rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid/ tha ma 'gag pa med pa rnam par thar pa'i sgo smon pa med pa'o/ /des na sems 'di dang po ma skyes pas tha ma rkyen gyis mi 'jig dus blo bur du ma byung bas/ gang stong 'phel 'grib med/ snang srid kun la khyab pas phyogs ris su ma chad/ dngos po dang mtshan mar ma grub pas 'di'o zhes mtshon du med/ ci yang ma 'gags ci yang ma grub pas/ rtag chad kyi mtha' las 'das/ dus gsum 'pho 'gyur med pas skye 'chi la gsal 'grib med/ rang bzhin ye nas dag pas 'khor ba'i skyon gyis ma gos pa rang bzhin gyi sangs rgyas yin te/

kye'i rdo rje las/ sems can rnams ni sangs rgyas nyid/ /ces so/ /de ni chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin yang yin te/ yab sras mjal ba'i mdo las/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag khams gsum po 'di dag ni sems tsam mo/ /zhes so/ /de ltar blos legs par gzhal te/ chos thams cad sems/ sems stong pa/ stong pa spros bral nam mkha' dwangs pa lta bur thag bcad do/ /de la sems kyi bzhag thabs bstan pa ni/ slob dpon bram ze chen pos/ gang la zhen pa yod na de yang thong / /rtogs par gyur na thams cad de yin te/ /de las gzhan zhig sus kyang mthong mi 'gyur/ /zhes dang / slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis kyang / glang chen loms nas sems tshags chud pa ltar/ /'gro 'ong bcad nas nga yi dam pa ste/ /'di ltar rtogs so nga la chos ci dgos/ /zhes pa ltar/ dang po sems kyi sems la nang du gnas te/ dus gsum dang 'brel ba'i shes pa gang yin brtag pa dang / 'brel ba ma yin na/ 'das pa'i rjes mi bcad ces dran par bya/ ma 'ong pa yin na sngun mi bsu pa dran par bya/ da ltar gyi shes pa yin na thug 'phrad du rang bzhin med par dran par bya ste/ dus gsum gri spros pa bcad nas sems spros bral gyi ngang du blan nas 'jog pa'o/ /der ma zad 'gyus pa'i rtog pa kho rang gi cher bltas pas chu zla ltar bcings grol gang yang med par snang stong du lhag gi mthong ba de ka'i ngang las lus sems ma bcos par sngar ltar bzhag ste/ sems nyid ngal bsor/ bu nyon gang la rnam par rtog /'dir bdag ma bcing ma grol phyir/ /ma yengs ma bcos rang gar ni/ /kye ho dub pa ngal sos shig /ces so/ /gzhan yang ting nge 'dzin gyis yon tan dran par byas nas bying rgod 'dul zhing nyon mongs rnam rtog gi nyes pa dran par bya ste/ ting nge 'dzin la mi dga' ba'i skyon gsal lo/ /gdams ngag brjed nas brnab sems lnga sogs pa'i nyon mongs rnam rtog 'phro na sngar gyi man ngag dran pa tsam gyi zhi bar byas pas sems la 'bad rtsol yod pa de srid du ting nge 'dzin rang gi ngang gis 'byung ba thob ste de ma bcos par lta ba mkhas pa glang po che skyong ba lta bu'i man ngag go

/de lhar sems la bcos slad med par de'i nyams dang ma bral bzhin no/ /rnam rtog sna tshogs kyi stengs du blo cham gyi btang bas rnam rtog gang shar thams cad kyi ngo bo blo bral du lhag song nas thams cad mi rtog pa'i ye shes 'ba' zhig tu rang gi ngang gi snying po la ma ltos par 'gro ba 'byung ste de ni mthar ci dgar bzhag la gzings thog nas bya 'phur ba lta bu'i man ngag go /gnas lugs de nyid la gzhi phyag rgya chen po lam phyag rgya chen po 'bras bu phyag rgya chen po gsum du yod pa'i gzhi phyag rgya chen po ni sems gsal stong zung 'jug yin par bshad zin la/ lam phyag rgya chen po ni gzhi de mngon du gyur pa'i thabs snang stong zung 'jug rig stong zung 'jug bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug bde stong zung 'jug sogs mang du yod kyang don spros bral de kho na nyid do/ /'bras bu phyag rgya chen po ni lam phyag rgya chen po bsgoms pas rnal 'byor pa'i srog stong pa nyid kyi sku la zhugs te/ sems rtog med rlung 'pho med khams 'dzag med kyi ting nge 'dzin mthar phyin pa'i rdo rje gsum gyi bdag nyid yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa nyid do/ /lung rnams ni mangs kyi dogs nas ma spros so/ /ji skad bshad pa de dag tshe 'di'i g.yengs rkyen spangs nas rtse gcig tu bsgom dgos te ma bsgom na ting nge 'dzin gyi yon tan gang yang mi 'byung zhing bsdus rgyud du/ rnal 'byor pa rnams 'khu bar byed na ngu 'bod la sogs dmyal ba chen po rnams kyi thar 'gror gyur/ zhes pa dang / 'phags pa sdong po bkod pa las/ yang dag sangs rgyas bstan pa 'di/ /thos pa tsam gyis mi 'grub bo/ /dper na la la chu klung gis/ /stobs med nan gyi khyer ba dag /skom nas shi bar gyur pa bzhin/ /ma bsgoms chos kyang de bzhin no/ /zhes dang 'phags pa sdong po bkod pa las/ dper na mtsho chen mnyam pa zhig

/skye bo thams cad sgrol byed kyang / /bdag nyid chus ni 'chi 'gyur ba/ /ma bsgom chos kyang de bzhin no/ /zhes so/ /des na sngar bstan pa'i ting nge 'dzin de'ang ma yis bu bskyang ba bzhin du bsam gtan gyi ma mas byang chub ma thob kyi bar du bskyangs shing / mchod pa rnams kyis nang nas mchog tu gyur pa rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes mnyes par byas pas dpag tu med pa'i srid pa gcod par byed/ ces so// ༈ /gnyis pa rjes thob kyi rnal 'byor la drug las/ bza' ba zas kyi rnal 'byor ni/ bza' btung ci yod oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs nas phud mchod dang / chang bu la sogs pa bya/ de nas rang kun 'dus rnam gnyis dang ci snang thugs rje chen por gsal ba thams cad kyis gsol bar bsam la tshim par longs spyad par bya'o// ༈ /bgo ba gos kyi rnal 'byor ni/ gos ci 'byor thams cad 'bru gsum brjod pas lha rdzas kyi na bzar byin gyis brlabs te/ rang dang lha thams cad kyi sku la gsol bar bsam la bgo bar bya'o// ༈ /'dug pa gnas khang gi rnal 'byor ni/ yul phyogs sam/ gnas khang gang yin dang / khyad par bstan gang yin la 'bru gsum gyis gzhal yas khang dang pad zla'i gdan tu byin gyis brlabs te kun 'dus rnam gnyis lha rnams dang bcas pa bzhugs par bsam la longs spyad do// ༈ /nyal ba gnyid kyi rnal 'byor ni/ rnal 'byor gzhan thams cad grub nas gnyid khar/ spyi bo'i bla ma kun 'dus la/ bdag la rmi lam mang po rmi bar byin gyis brlabs tu gsol/ rmi lam la rmi lam du ngo shes par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ rmi lam 'od gsal du rtogs par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba drag tu btab nas/ rang gi snying kha'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas spyi bo'i bla ma spyan drangs/ tshangs bug nas zhugs/ dbu ma nas brgyud de snying kha'i thugs rje chen po'i spyi bor zhugs par bsam la/

bla ma'i sku las 'od dmar po 'phros pas/ yi dam gsal bar byas/ yi dam las 'od dkar po 'phros pas bla ma gsal bar byas pa la sems gtad nas/ gnyid log pas/ dang por gang byung de rmi lam yin par ngo shes/ de chos dbyings 'od gsal chen por rtogs par 'byung zhing / 'di la goms nas sprul sgyur gyi sgo nas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas la chos nyan pa sogs/ 'dod don thams cad bsgrub nus pa 'byung bas nan tan cher bya'o/ /gnyid sad pa'i tshe/ mkha' 'gro sde lngas ḍā ma ru'i sgras bskul bas gnyid sad par bsam/ rdzogs rim gyi ngang du nyal na/ rang gi thugs kha'i hrīḥlas 'od 'phros pas khams gsum snod bcud thams cad rang yi dam du gsal ba la bsdu/ de hrīḥl bsdu/ hrīḥyang 'od du yal ba'i ngang las ma yengs par gnyid log go /'di la yang lus gnad dang / dus gnad la sogs pa'i khyad par sngar dang 'dra'o/ /khrus kyi rnal 'byor ni bla med gzhan dang 'dra'o/ /lnga pa 'pho ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ rgyas par na skyabs 'gro nas bzlas pa'i bar bya/ bsdu na/ skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed ni/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i don du 'pho ba'i rnal 'byor nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ /zhes sems dang 'gre nges lan gsum bya/ dngos gzhi la gsum ste/ 'chi ba rim gyis pa la rim gyis nyams su blang ba'i tshul dang / 'chi ba cig car ba la btsan thabs su 'pho ba dang / skyon yon gyi sgo nas mjug bsdu ba'o/ /dang po sbyang ba dang las sbyar ba gnyis kyi/ sbyang ba'i dus ni 'chi ltas brtag cing / 'chi bslu bya/ ma bslus na zla ba drug tsam gyis gong rim la sogs pas ma phog par/ 'pho ba sbyong ba'i dus yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa rnal 'byor pa rlung la legs par goms pas/ rlung rgyu tshul la brtag pa sogs man ngag du ma nas 'byung ba ltar brtags nas/ 'di tsam la 'chi ba'i rtags la nges pa thob pa'i tshe sbyang bar bya zhing /

khyad par du dus nye ba'i 'chi ltas rtsa'i nus pa nyams pa'i rtags/ spyi gtsug gi rlangs pa yal ba dang / rlung gi nus pa nyams pa'i rtags rna ba'i 'ur sgra chad pa dang / thig le'i nus pa nyams pa'i rtags mig gi 'od dkar po nyams pa dang gsum ka 'dzoms pa lta bu'am/ yang na da lta nas sbyangs kyang shin tu legs pa yin te/ bla ma gnyan gyi gsung nas/ ma bsgom 'pho ba'i gdams ngag ces gsungs kyang / da lta shes pa gsal dus nas bsgom dgos dar chen dar chung thug pa'i dus su 'pho mi nus/ lkugs pa'i brda mtshon dka'/ mi phal mo che cig phyi ma bas zla ba phyi ma snga snyam ste/ zla ba phyi ma bas tshe phyi ma ngos snga ba srid/ des na 'ong nges shes pa 'chi ba yin pas/ 'chi dus sangs rgyas pa'i man ngag 'di lta bu cig tshags su chud dgos/ zhes gsungs te/ nam 'chi nges med la bsam na shin tu gnad che ba'i gdams par gda' 'o/ /ji ltar sbyang ba ni/ lus yi dam gyi sku phru ma bus pa lta bu/ khog pa stong seng nge bar bsam pa'i spyi bor/ bla ma 'od dpag med kyi rnam pa/ byams pa 'khor lo'i bzhugs stangs ltar 'dug pa'i zhabs gnyis tshangs bug gi g.yas g.yon du bzhag par bsam/ rang gi lus kyi dbus na yar rtsa dbu ma phyi dkar la nang dmar ba spyi gtsug nas lte 'og sor bzhi'i bar du sleb pa/ sbom phra sba lcag 'bring po tsam bsam pa'i yar sna tshangs pa'i bu gar haṃ sngo skya mgo thur bstan gyis bkag pa'i mjug ma nas/ bla ma'i thugs rje'i 'od zer gyi lcags kyus 'then par bsam/ de nas dbu ma'i nang gi snying kha'i thad kar yi dam mthe'u chung tsam gsal la dwangs pa/ dbu ma'i ma snar gsang gnas su chos 'byung gru gsum mthing nag gi zur gcig mdun dang / zur gnyis logs g.yas g.yon la gtad pa'i steng du/ sems kyi rten thig le dkar dmar sngo ba'i mdangs can/ 'od zer lnga 'phro ba gcig bsam ste/ ༈ /dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad 'dus pa'i dngos/

/skyabs gnas bla ma mchog dang dbyer med pa'i/ /'dren mchog 'od dpag med la gsol ba 'debs/ /tshe 'di blo yis thong bar byin gyis rlobs/ /dgos med rgyud la skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /bdag 'dzin rtsad nas chod par byin gyis rlobs/ /lam mchog 'pho ba 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs/ /'chug med mkha' spyod 'grub par byin gyi rlobs/ spro na gsol 'debs rgyas pa zur du 'byung ba ltar bya'o/ /zhes gsol ba btab cing 'og rlung 'then pas rlung gi stobs kyis thig le zhig song ste/ de nas thig le sngo skya dung g.yu'i mdog lta bu sran ma tsam gcig chad/ hika zhes brjod pas dbu ma nas yar song / snying gi yi dam la bskor ba gcig byas/ spyi bo'i haṃ la sor rdo rgyab pa bzhin phog pa dang / spyi bo'i bla ma'i thugs rje'i 'od zer gyi lcags kyus tshangs bug gi haṃ 'then nas/ spyi gtsug rgya skar phye ba bzhin skya thal byung bar bsam la/ yang 'og sgo cung zad slod cing ka zhes brjod pas/ thig le mar sngo hri li li byung thugs kha'i yi dam la bskor ba byas nas/ gsang gnas kyi gzhi'i thig le la thim pas/ kha dog sna tshogs su gyur/ yang 'og rlung 'then pas sngar bzhin thig le yar byung / yi dam la bskor ba cig tshangs bug nas 'thon/ bla ma'i thugs kar reg tsam gcig byas/ mar byung yi dam la bskor ba byas/ gzhi'i thig le la thim par bsam/ de lta bu gcig nas nyi shu rtsa gcig gi bar kha yar du 'byongs rtags ma byung gi bar du nyams su blangs/ sbyang ba'i tshe/ 'pho rab tshe thung bya ba yin pas/ de'i gnyen por thun gyi mjug tu spyi bo'i bla ma 'od du zhu snying kha'i yi dam la thim/ tshangs bug haṃ gis bcad de sra zhing brtan par gyur/ yi dam 'od du zhu tshe'i rang bzhin gyi bdud rtsis lus kyi nang khengs/ lte ba'i thig le la thim par bsam zhing / rlung bum pa can gsum mam bdun nam nyer gcig sogs gang 'os bzung bas tshe bsgrub kyi mchog yin no/

/'di la sdig po che gseb lam nas btsan thabs su sangs rgyas pa'i man ngag gam/ ma bsgom pa'i sangs rgyas 'pho ba'i gdam ngag ces zer te/ rtags ni spyi bo tsha ba dang sbos pa sogs byung na bcos slad mi bya ba gnad yin gsung / rtags ma byung na spog chog ni/ gzhan sngar dang 'dra ba la/ yi dam gyi dbu'i gtsug tor lcags kyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa gcig tu bsam/ 'og rlung hi ka zhes pa'i ngag gi 'dren pas yar 'dren pa dang / gzhi'i thig le thams cad yar yi dam la bskor ba byas thugs kar thim/ yi dam yang yar byung / tshangs bug nas sku phyed yan chad steng du thol byung / gtsug tor gyi rdo rje'i rwa nas/ bla ma'i thugs rje'i 'od zer gyi lcags kyus drag tu 'then par bsam/ de nas ka zhes pa'i ngag gi 'gyur bas/ 'og rlung slod pa dang / yi dam mar byung thugs kar zhugs/ thig le thugs kha nas thon mar byung / chos 'byung gi thig le la thim par bsgom/ de yang mang nyung nyams la dri/ thun 'jog tsa na yi dam gyi thugs kha nas 'od 'phros/ spyi gtsug gi bla ma la phog pas dbu ma na mar byon/ tshangs bug ham gis bkag bla ma yi dam gyi spyi gtsug tu bzhugs kar bsam mo/ /gegs sel ni/ bsgoms drags nas rlung stod du 'tshang ba dang / mgo bo na ba sogs dang / ro stod na/ sems 'phro rgod du gyur pa ma chod pa sogs byung na/ ro stod khrol tshags lta bur yod par bsgom la/ rlung ro ngan pa rnams bun nu nu thon par bsam pa'am/ thig le chos 'byung gi zhabs nas brgyud de/ bshang lam nas 'thon/ sa 'og rim pa bdun gyi bar du song ba la rig pa gtad pa la sogs pas dmigs pa smad du gtad pa sogs bya'o/ /gnyis pa las la sbyar ba la/ dus nam gyi tshe las sbyar ba/ tshul ji ltar las la sbyar ba/ de ltar 'byongs pa'i phan yon dang gsum/ dang po ni/ gdan bzhi las/ dus la bab na 'pho bya ste/ /dus min lha rnams gsod par 'gyur/

/zhes gsungs te/ de la dus ni/ spyir sems can rnams dang po skye ba na yang 'byung ba bzhi'i rim pas skye gnas pa na lang 'byung ba bzhi'i ngo bor gnas/ 'jig pa na yang 'byung ba bzhi'i rim pas 'jig pa yin zhing / khyad par du gnyis med rnam rgyal las/ lus can rnams ni 'chi ba'i tshe/ /sa ni chu la thim par 'gyur/ /chu ni me la thim 'gyur te/ /me ni rlung la thim par 'gyur/ /rlung ni rnam par shes la thim/ /rnam shes bzung ba de nyid ni/ /'od gsal ba la 'jug par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pas/ dang po 'byung ba 'jig pa'i rtags ni 'di lta ste/ sa chu la thim na lus lci zhing bsgul bskyod dka'/ mjing pas mgo mi theg yan lag gi 'phrang shor/ lag pas gos sogs la nom zhing nyul/ mig khong du rdib cing mi gsal/ nang du ma rig sgyu lta bu'i snang ba 'char ro/ /'dir sa chu la thim pa zhes pa yang sa chu la thim pa'i mgo tsam ba nas de ltar 'byung ba'i don yin pas/ thim zin pa kho na'i rtags ma yin no/ /de bzhin du chu me la thim na kha sna skam/ mchu mi 'dus/ so rtseg cing dreg pa 'chags/ sna zhom zhing dri mi tshor/ rna bas kyang sgra mi thos/ nang du du ba lta bu'i snang ba 'char ro/ /me rlung la thim na drod mtha' nas bsdu/ gdong gi bkrag mdangs nyams/ lce thung zhing gtam mi lcogs/ ro mi tshor/ nang du me khyer lta bu'i snang ba 'char ro/ /rlung rnam shes la thim na/ dbugs phyir 'gro ba ring zhing nang du sdud pa thung / reg bya mi tshor/ bshang gci mi thub/ nang du mar me lta bu snang ba 'char ro/ /rnam shes la gnas skabs gsum ste/ de yang dam pa dang po'i rgyud las/ lus can thams cad 'chi ba na/ /bdud rtsi zla ba thur du 'bab/ /zla mtshan nyi ma gyen du ste/ /rnam shes srid pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /zhes gsungs pas/ dang po pha las thob pa'i dkar cha byang chub kyi sems dbu ma'i yas sna na rtsa rkyang ma'i nus pas bzung nas gnas pa de nyid/

thur du 'bab pa las stong pa zhes bya ba dkar lam zla ba shar ba lta bu'i snang ba 'char zhing / de'i tshe 'dod chags las gyur pa'i rnam rtog so gsum 'gag de nas ma las thob pa'i dmar cha byang chub kyi sems dbu ma'i mas sna na rtsa ro ma'i nus pas bzung nas gnas pa de nyid gyen du bskyod pa las/ stong pa chen po zhes bya ba dmar lam nyi ma shar ba lta bu'i snang ba 'char shing / de'i tshe zhe sdang las gyur pa'i rnam rtog bzhi bcu 'gag byang chub kyi sems dkar dmar de gnyis snying khar phrad cing zung du 'jug pa las shin tu stong pa zhes bya ba nag lam srod kyi mun nag gtug po lta bu 'char la/ de'i tshe gti mug las gyur pa'i rnam rtog bdun 'gag cing / de'i mthar thams cad stong pa zhes bya ba spros pa thams cad dang bral ba'i 'od gsal la don dam pa'i ye shes 'char ba yin no/ /de ltar na 'chi ba lam du byed pa'i tshe/ gal po cher byed pa'i rtags bzhi dang stong pa bzhi zhes pa ni/ sngar brjod pa de dag ste/ de yang stong pa dang po gsum gnyis snang dang bcas pa yin pas/ rgyud der/ rnam shes bzung ba/ zhes gsungs pa yin no de ltar nag lam gyi snang ba shar ba'i tshe/ shes pa skad cig ma'i steng du sngar gyi blo 'das phyag rgya chen po'i ngang las ma yengs par 'jog pa la/ de bzhin nyid kyi 'pho ba zer zhing / de ltar bzhag pas 'od gsal ma bu mjal nas/ 'chi ba chos kyi skur 'tshang rgya ba zer ba de 'byung ba yin no/ /de yang ye nas rig pa 'od gsal du gnas pa de ma/ 'chi ba'i 'od gsal de bu/ de gnyis lam gyi 'od gsal gyis 'tshams 'byor ba la 'od gsal ma bu 'phrod pa zer ba lags/ 'dir skabs su bab pa ni/ phyi dbugs chad kha ma dbugs nang du rgyu ba shin du thung bar gyur pa'i tshe 'pho bar bya ste/ de las 'phyis na/ dbang shes rags pa rnams thim pas/ gzhan gyis gsal 'debs pa'i sgra mi thos pa dang / yid shes kyang shin tu phra ba las med pas/

rang gis kyang dmigs pa rnams mi 'chun zhing / khyad par rnam shes rlung la skyon dgos pas/ rlung rdzogs par thim na tshul de mi rung ba'i phyir ro/ /des na gdams ngag 'di nyams su len pa la'ang med du mi rung ba'i gnad rnam pa gsum ste/ tshe 'di la ma chags pa dang / gang 'pho bar 'dod pa'i gnas su 'gro bar 'dod pa'i 'dun pa drag po dang / gdams ngag la yid ches pa'o// ༈ /gnyis pa tshul ji ltar las la sbyar ba ni/ rdo rje gur las/ rnam shes bla mar 'pho ba ni/ /spros pa thams cad rab bcad nas/ /rgyal sras lam la bsam par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar dngos po gang yod spong dag bya/ 'khor dang nye du sogs kyi 'brel bcad/ 'khon yod na sbyang / sdom pa 'og ma gnyis sngar ma blangs na gsar du blangs zhing sngar blangs ba nyams pa yin na gso/ grub na dbang zhu ba la sogs pa byas te/ sngar bshad pa ltar gyi dus la bab pa na/ 'og rlung 'then nus sam mi nus kyang rung ste/ chos 'byung gi nang gi sems kyi rten du gyur pa'i thig le yar myur du byung / snying rje'i yi dam la thim/ yi dam yang myur du yar byon te skar mda' 'phangs pa ltar tshangs bug nas rgyangs kyis thon te/ bla ma'i thugs kar bstims nas ma bcos gnyug ma'i don la bzhag par bya'o/ /gsum pa las la 'byor pa'i phan yon ni/ de ltar spyi gtsug ser sgo nas 'phos na/ sngar byas kyi sdig pas mi gos shing / nges par 'phags pa'i sa thob par 'gyur te/ gdan bzhi las/ tshigs dgu las ni yar ston na/ /mdo la 'pho ba zhes bya ste/ /nyin re bram ze gsod pa dang / /'tshams med lnga ni byed pa dang / /rku dang 'dod pa'i longs spyod rnams/ /'di yi lam gyis 'gag par 'gyur/ /sdig gis gos par mi 'gyur zhing / /srid pa'i dngos po ring bar 'gyur/ /ji ltar 'dam las skyes pa yi/ /pad+ma'i mdangs ni mdzes pa ltar/ /de bzhin dman pa'i lus dag la/ /ye shes sku ni rang dgar 'byung /

/zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /bla ma gnyan gyi zhal nas/ spyir 'pho ba la/ byin rlabs bla ma'i 'pho ba/ zung 'jug yi dam gyi 'pho ba/ chos nyid don dam pa'i 'pho ba/ sku gsum gyi 'pho ba/ thig le dkar dmar gyi 'pho ba/ 'od kyi gong bu'i 'pho ba sogs du ma yod de/ gang ltar byas kyang 'ong gsungs/ de rnams kyi nang nas 'di ni byin rlabs bla ma'i 'pho ba yin no// ༈ /yang g.yang las lhung ba'am/ chus khyer ba la sogs pa 'chi ba cig car ba la bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyi don dran par bya'o/ /gal te sgo ngan pa 'gegs pa dang / sgo bzang po tshangs bug 'byed pa la sogs pa med pas mi zab bo snyam na/ bla ma gnyan gyi gsung nas/ bskyed rdzogs kyi don dran pa tsam gyis sgo ngan pa rnams rang 'gag la 'gro gsung ngo / /tha ma lus bcos te 'pho ba ni/ nus na skyil krung ngam tsog pu bya/ mi nus na mgo bo shar ram byang du bstan/ gzhogs g.yas 'og tu bcug skyil krung ngam tsog pu ltar na mdun du dang / g.yas nyal ltar na mgo bo phyogs su sku gsung thugs kyi rten dang mchod pa ci 'byor pa bsham/ reg pa dang klag cor sogs byed dgos/ byung na stod kyi phyogs 'ba' zhig tu bya/ bla ma dang yi dam la mos gus byed du gzhug spyi gtsug gi skra nas 'then/ thabs de lta bu dud 'gro la yang byas na bzang gsungs so/ /skabs 'dir bla ma gong ma'i gsung las/ bla ma grub khong ba rang yang / gong du bshad pa lta bu'i steng nas 'pho ba mdzad/ bskyed rim bsgom pa la lha sku 'byon par gsungs te/ /gdung la rdo rje phag mo'i sku gcig byon/ rdzogs rim bsgoms pa la ring bsrel 'byon par gsungs te/ gdung thal thams cad ring bsrel du song / 'od zer gyi spro bsdu bsgom pa la 'ja' 'od 'byung bar gsungs te/ gdung la 'ja' 'od kyi 'phreng bar byon/ bzlas pa byas pa la ljags dang / byang chub kyis sems bsgom pa la thugs 'byon par gsungs te/

ljags thugs 'brel ba gcig byon gsungs so/ /gsum pa skyon yon gnyis kyi sgo nas mjug bsdu ba ni/ 'chi ltas kyi gtugs bzhin du 'di lta bu'i rnal 'byor gyi steng nas tshangs bug nas ma 'phos par/ 'og gi lam nas 'phos na ngan song du skye bar 'gyur te/ mkha' 'gro ma kun tu brtags pa'i rgyud las/ rnam shes rlung la zhon nas ni/ /'og gi lam nas 'phos gyur na/ /chos la goms pa'i gang zag kyang / /ngan song dag tu skye bar 'gyur/ /mgron po lam du zhugs pa'i mi/ /grogs kyi bsgyur ba ji bzhin no/ /zhes so/ /dus su 'phos pa'i yon tan ni/ rgyud de nyid las/ rnam shes rlung zhon nas ni/ /steng gi lam nas 'phos gyur na/ /sdig la goms pa'i gang zag kyang / mtho ris dag tu skye bar 'gyur/ /mgron po lam du zhugs pa'i mi/ /grogs kyis bsgyur ba ji bzhin no/ /zhes so/ /des na 'pho ba'i nyams len la 'bad pa gal che zhing / 'di lta bu'i man ngag la brten nas steng gi lam shes nas mkha' spyod du 'pho ba'i rnal 'byor pa dang / rnal 'byor ma ni shin tu dkon te/ mkha' 'gro kun spyod las/ 'chi ba zhes bya rnam rtog ste/ /mkha' la spyod pa'i gnas su 'khyer/ /de lta'i rnal 'byor pa dang ni/ /rnal 'byor ma ni shin tu dkon/ /zhes so/ /drug pa bar dor sangs rgyas 'od gsal gyi rnal 'byor la gsum las/ sbyor ba skyabs 'gro sems bskyed ni sngar dang 'dra la/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi 'od gsal gyi rnal 'byor ni/ da lta nyid nas bar do sbyang dgos pas/ 'di ltar nyams su blangs te/ 'di ltar thog mar rang shi nas/ bar dor ming gzhi'i phung por gnas par bsam la/ de'i rjes su a tsa ma nga shi ba yin par 'dug pas/ bar do 'od gsal sngon du bya dgos snyam pa'i 'dun pa drag po dang / bya ba gang dang gang byed pa thams cad bar do'i bya ba yin pa'i dran pa ma yengs pa yang dang yang du byas shing / bar do 'di nyid du phyag rgya chen po mngon du byed dgos te/
